<div class="block"><p>Set a new color for the light based on its category.</div>
<dl>

</dl>

<a id="setIntensity(com.here.sdk.mapview.MapSceneLights.Category,double,com.here.sdk.mapview.MapSceneLights.AttributeSettingCallback)">

</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setIntensity</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setIntensity&#8203;(@NonNull
                         <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapscenelights-category" title="enum in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapSceneLights.Category</a>&nbsp;category,
                         double&nbsp;intensity,
                         @Nullable
                         <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapscenelights-attributesettingcallback" title="interface in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapSceneLights.AttributeSettingCallback</a>&nbsp;callback)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Set a new intensity for the light based on its category.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>category</code> - <p>The category of light for which the intensity is set.</dd>
<dd><code>intensity</code> - <p>The light intensity value must be inside the range [0, 10].
     The intensity value is clamped to this range.
     If the value falls outside its supported range, it will be adjusted to stay within the range.
     Note: When the intensity value is big,
     3D objects might turn completely white because all the color channels could go over the limit of 1.0.</dd>
<dd><code>callback</code> - <p>Optional callback that will receive the result of this operation.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
